title: Entrepreneurs First US
description: Entrepreneurs First backs exceptional individuals in San Francisco, often before they have a cofounder, company or idea. Two paths: up to $250K invested on day one for founders ready to go all in, with three months living and working in EF's SF residency and a Demo Day; or the Fellowship Residency, an equity-free $10K grant and housing for three months to explore. Rolling applications.
reward: Up to $250K investment on day one ($125K post-money SAFE for 8% from EF, plus an optional $125K uncapped MFN SAFE), or an equity-free $10K Fellowship grant
summary: up to $250,000 investment or $10,000 grant · rolling

eligibility.note: live and work in San Francisco for the first three months (strongly encouraged; required for the second $125,000)

rules: Rolling: EF reviews every application. If you don't hear back, EF is passing for now; no individual feedback is given.
Shortlisted applicants go through interviews with EF's U.S. team, advisors, alumni and leadership.

The $250,000 path: $125,000 via a post-money SAFE for 8% from EF, plus an optional $125,000 uncapped MFN SAFE from EF and Transpose Platform if you relocate to San Francisco and incorporate as a Delaware C-Corp.
The Fellowship Residency: an equity-free $10,000 grant and housing for three months to explore ideas and cofounders, with a path to EF's full investment.
Living and working in San Francisco for the first three months is strongly encouraged and required for the second $125,000; residents get a founder house, coaching and a Demo Day for U.S. investors.
You do not need a cofounder or an idea to apply. If you already have a cofounder, mention it and ask them to apply too.
